verdict.rationale: Pipecat Cloud exposes a REST API for managing agents, secrets and builds, so bulk operations are a fair question, but nothing in the evidence documents batch or bulk endpoints or multi-item actions. Multi-agent parallel fan-out and unlimited session concurrency are related runtime features, not bulk operations over many items, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
